remaining_monolith_responsibilities: ConsoleActivity retains Android UI adapters, progress text, intent dispatch and existing host lookup; it no longer chooses preparation ordering or ambiguous session success.

test_seam: Package-visible production collaborators and controlled clocks/effects drive ordering, correlation, timeout, cancellation and late-callback cases deterministically without sleeps.
